# data prep
```{r}

# load libraries
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)

# load data
lmsys_A <- stream_in(file('../data/processed/classified_candidates_full_1m_belief_crossturn.jsonl'))
lmsys_B <- stream_in(file('../data/processed/classified_candidates_full_1m_all_policy_sem1000.jsonl'))
wild_A <-  stream_in(file('../data/processed/classified_wildchat_candidates_full_1m_belief_crossturn.jsonl'))
wild_B <-  stream_in(file('../data/processed/classified_wildchat_candidates_full_1m_all_policy_sem1000.jsonl'))

# combine and dedupe convos
lmsys <- bind_rows(lmsys_A, lmsys_B) %>%
  distinct(conversation_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
wild <- bind_rows(wild_A, wild_B) %>%
  distinct(conversation_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# color palette
redBlue <- c('#407EC9', '#CE3333')
cslPal <- c(
  '#CE3333',  # red
  '#593C8F',  # purple
  '#407EC9',  # light blue
  '#E8A03E',  # orange
  '#083D77',  # dark blue
  '#c2c4c4',  # grey
  '#17C3B2'  # green
  )

# set font for figures
windowsFonts(fra = windowsFont('Fira Sans'))

# remove clutter
rm(lmsys_A, lmsys_B, wild_A, wild_B)

```

# summarize funnels
```{r}
# function for summarizing funnels
summfunnel <- function(x, lbl) {

  # num of rows
  n <- nrow(x)

  # Hierarchical 3-stage filter (x -> s1 -> s2 -> s3)
  s1 <- x %>%
    filter(is_policy_or_political == TRUE)
  s2 <- s1 %>%
    filter(user_states_prior_belief == TRUE)
  s3 <- s2 %>%
    filter(seeking_type %in% c('confirming', 'neutral', 'falsifying'))

  # output dataframe (check.names = FALSE keeps spaces/colons in column names)
  output <- data.frame(
    'Dataset' = as.character(lbl),
    'Candidates Classified' = n,
    'Stage 1: Policy Topic' = paste0(nrow(s1), ' (', round(100 * nrow(s1) / n, 1), '%)'),
    'Stage 2: Prior Belief Stated' = paste0(nrow(s2), ' (', round(100 * nrow(s2) / nrow(s1), 1), '% of S1)'),
    'Stage 3: Info-Seeking Query' = paste0(nrow(s3), ' (', round(100 * nrow(s3) / nrow(s2), 1), '% of S2)'),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  return(output)
}

# print summary across LMSYS, WildChat, and Combined 2M
bind_rows(
  summfunnel(lmsys, 'LMSYS-Chat-1M (1M Raw)'),
  summfunnel(wild, 'WildChat-1M (1M Raw)'),
  summfunnel(bind_rows(lmsys, wild), 'Combined 2M Corpus (2M Raw)')
)

# filter by policy, prior belief, and seeking type
lmsys <- lmsys %>%
  filter(is_policy_or_political == TRUE,
         user_states_prior_belief == TRUE,
         seeking_type %in% c('confirming', 'neutral', 'falsifying')) %>%
  mutate(source = 'lmsys')

wild <- wild %>%
  filter(is_policy_or_political == TRUE,
         user_states_prior_belief == TRUE,
         seeking_type %in% c('confirming', 'neutral', 'falsifying')) %>%
  mutate(source = 'wild')


# combine Stage-3 data (N = 455)
combined <- bind_rows(lmsys, wild)

```


# hypothesis tests across datasets
```{r}

# lmsys confirming vs. neutral vs. falsifying
lmsys %>%
  group_by(seeking_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            percent = round(n / nrow(.), 3)*100) 

# falsify ratio
paste0('LMSYS Falsify Ratio: ', round(221 / 31, 2), 'x')

# lmsys confirming vs. neutral vs. falsifying
wild %>%
  group_by(seeking_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            percent = round(n / nrow(.), 3)*100) 


paste0('WildChat Falsify Ratio: ', round(65 / 9, 2), 'x')


# combined
combined %>%
  group_by(seeking_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            percent = round(n / nrow(.), 3)*100) 

paste0('combined Falsify Ratio: ', round(286 / 40, 2), 'x')


# binomial test (conf > fals)
binom.test(286, 286 + 40, p = 0.5, alternative = c('two.sided'), conf.level = 0.95)

# binomial test (conf > fals + neutral)
binom.test(286, 286 + 40 + 129, p = 0.5, alternative = c('two.sided'), conf.level = 0.95)


```

# figures

## percent by source
```{r}

# data
tmp <- combined %>%
  group_by(source, seeking_type) %>%
  reframe(num = n()) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(num), .by = source) %>%
  mutate(percent = round(num / total, 3)*100)
tmpc <- combined %>%
  group_by(seeking_type) %>%
  reframe(num = n()) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(num)) %>%
  mutate(percent = round(num / total, 4)*100) %>%
    mutate(source = 'combined')
tmp <- bind_rows(tmp, tmpc)

tmp <- tmp %>%
  mutate(seeking_type = case_when(
    seeking_type == 'confirming' ~ 'Confirming',
    seeking_type == 'falsifying' ~ 'Falsifying',
    seeking_type == 'neutral' ~ 'Neutral',
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  mutate(source = case_when(
    source == 'lmsys' ~ 'LMSYS-Chat',
    source == 'wild' ~ 'WildChat',
    source == 'combined' ~ 'Combined',
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))
  

# plot
p <- ggplot(tmp, aes(x = source, y = percent, fill = fct_reorder(seeking_type, percent))) +
       geom_bar(stat = 'identity', color = '#000', alpha = .8) +
       geom_text(aes(label = paste0(percent, '%')),
                 position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
                 color = '#fff',
                 size = 6) +
       coord_flip() +
       scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0,0)) +
       scale_fill_manual(values = cslPal) +
       labs(
         title = 'Confirming Language was used more than\nNeutral or Falsifying Language',
         x = NULL,
         y = 'Percent of Sample',
         fill = NULL,
         caption = '\nCombined N = 455\nCalifornia Social Labs'
       ) +
       theme_minimal() +
       guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
         # facet_grid(~ fct_rev(source)) +
       theme(
         text = element_text(family = 'fra', size = 20),
         title = element_text(size = 18),
         # plot.title = element_text(margin = margin(0, 0, 20, 0)),
         plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 14, color = '#7e7e7e'),
         axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(15, 0, 0, 0)),
         axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(0, 15, 0, 0)),
         axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
         axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
         strip.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'),
         # legend.key = element_rect(size = 5, color = 'white'),
         # legend.key.size = unit(2.5, 'lines'),
         legend.position = 'bottom',
         plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 40, b = 10, l = 10, unit = 'pt'),
         panel.spacing = unit(1.5, 'lines'))

# save to file
png('../figures/p1.png', units = 'in', width = 10, height = 6, res = 500)
plot(p)
dev.off()

```
## percent by policy
```{r}

# data
tmp <- combined %>%
  group_by(seeking_type, topic_category) %>%
  reframe(num = n()) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(num), .by = topic_category) %>%
  mutate(percent = round(num / total, 3)*100)

tmp <- tmp %>%
  mutate(seeking_type = case_when(
    seeking_type == 'confirming' ~ 'Confirming',
    seeking_type == 'falsifying' ~ 'Falsifying',
    seeking_type == 'neutral' ~ 'Neutral',
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  mutate(topic_category = case_when(
    topic_category == 'economic_policy' ~ 'Economic Policy\n(n = 62)',
    topic_category == 'social_policy' ~ 'Social Policy\n(n = 343)',
    topic_category == 'politics' ~ 'Politics\n(n = 50)',
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

# plot
p <- ggplot(tmp, aes(x = topic_category, y = percent, fill = fct_reorder(seeking_type, percent))) +
       geom_bar(stat = 'identity', color = '#000', alpha = .8) +
       geom_text(aes(label = paste0(percent, '%')),
                 position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
                 color = '#fff',
                 size = 6) +
       coord_flip() +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0,0)) +
       scale_fill_manual(values = cslPal) +

    labs(
      title = '\"Politics\" Category had greater share of\nFalsifying Language',
      x = NULL,
      y = 'Percent of Sample',
      fill = NULL,
      caption = '\nCombined N = 455\nCalifornia Social Labs'
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
       # facet_grid(~ fct_rev(source)) +
    theme(
        text = element_text(family = 'fra', size = 20),
        title = element_text(size = 18),
        # plot.title = element_text(margin = margin(0, 0, 20, 0)),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 14, color = '#7e7e7e'),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(15, 0, 0, 0)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(0, 15, 0, 0)),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'),
        # legend.key = element_rect(size = 5, color = 'white'),
        # legend.key.size = unit(2.5, 'lines'),
        legend.position = 'bottom',
        plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 40, b = 10, l = 10, unit = 'pt'),
        panel.spacing = unit(1.5, 'lines'))

# save to file
png('../figures/p2.png', units = 'in', width = 10, height = 6, res = 500)
plot(p)
dev.off()


```
